title: Ward local config
description: Contents of `ward.local.yml`: personal overrides merged on top of the main config, not committed. https://github.com/hexlabelposition/ward#local-overrides

hooks.description: Hooks to change, add or remove (`null`). A command or a list replaces the hook, `{ tasks }` is merged into it by task name.

applypatch-msg.description: `git am`, before a patch is applied. `{1}` is the file with the proposed commit message.

applypatchMsg.description: `git am`, before a patch is applied. `{1}` is the file with the proposed commit message. Same as `applypatch-msg`.

pre-applypatch.description: `git am`, after a patch is applied and before it is committed.

preApplypatch.description: `git am`, after a patch is applied and before it is committed. Same as `pre-applypatch`.

post-applypatch.description: `git am`, after a patch is committed.

postApplypatch.description: `git am`, after a patch is committed. Same as `post-applypatch`.

pre-commit.description: `git commit`, before the commit message is asked for. Tasks get the staged files.

preCommit.description: `git commit`, before the commit message is asked for. Tasks get the staged files. Same as `pre-commit`.

pre-merge-commit.description: `git merge`, before a merge commit is created.

preMergeCommit.description: `git merge`, before a merge commit is created. Same as `pre-merge-commit`.

prepare-commit-msg.description: `git commit`, before the message editor opens. `{1}` is the message file, `{2}` the message source.

prepareCommitMsg.description: `git commit`, before the message editor opens. `{1}` is the message file, `{2}` the message source. Same as `prepare-commit-msg`.

commit-msg.description: `git commit`, after the message is written. `{1}` is the message file.

commitMsg.description: `git commit`, after the message is written. `{1}` is the message file. Same as `commit-msg`.

post-commit.description: `git commit`, after the commit is created.

postCommit.description: `git commit`, after the commit is created. Same as `post-commit`.

pre-rebase.description: `git rebase`, before it starts. `{1}` is the upstream.

preRebase.description: `git rebase`, before it starts. `{1}` is the upstream. Same as `pre-rebase`.

post-checkout.description: `git checkout` / `git switch`, after the worktree is updated. `{1}` previous HEAD, `{2}` new HEAD, `{3}` 1 for a branch checkout.

postCheckout.description: `git checkout` / `git switch`, after the worktree is updated. `{1}` previous HEAD, `{2}` new HEAD, `{3}` 1 for a branch checkout. Same as `post-checkout`.

postMerge.description: `git merge` / `git pull`, after a merge. Same as `post-merge`.

pre-push.description: `git push`, before anything is pushed. Tasks get the files of the pushed commits. `{1}` remote name, `{2}` URL.

prePush.description: `git push`, before anything is pushed. Tasks get the files of the pushed commits. `{1}` remote name, `{2}` URL. Same as `pre-push`.

preAutoGc.description: `git gc --auto`, before it runs. Same as `pre-auto-gc`.

post-rewrite.description: `git commit --amend` / `git rebase`, after commits are rewritten. `{1}` is the command.

postRewrite.description: `git commit --amend` / `git rebase`, after commits are rewritten. `{1}` is the command. Same as `post-rewrite`.

sendemail-validate.description: `git send-email`, for each patch. `{1}` is the patch file.

sendemailValidate.description: `git send-email`, for each patch. `{1}` is the patch file. Same as `sendemail-validate`.

command.description: Shell command, run from the repo root. `{1}`, `{2}` … are git hook arguments; `{staged_files}`, `{push_files}` (`pre-push` only) and `{all_files}` are files.

hook.description: What the hook runs: one command, a list of commands run in order (stop on the first failure), or `{ tasks: { name: { run: "…" } } }`.

tasks.description: Named tasks, run in the order they are listed.

parallel.description: Start all tasks at once and let each run to the end; the hook fails if any of them fails. Tasks run one after another by default.

backup.description: Save the index and working tree with `git stash create` before the run, so they can be restored if a task breaks them. `false` skips it to save time in large repos.

revert.description: When a task fails, put the index and working tree back as they were before the run, from the backup. `false` keeps the tasks' changes for inspection. Needs `backup`.

glob.description: Files the task runs on: one pattern or a list, any of them may match. A pattern without `/` matches the file name in any directory (`"*.ts"`), one with `/` the path from the repo root.

exclude.description: Files to leave out even when `glob` matches them, same pattern rules.

symlinks.description: Pass symlinks to the task too. Off by default: a formatter would rewrite the file the link points to.

stageFixed.description: `git add` the staged files the task changed, so a formatter's fixes go into the commit. `false` leaves them unstaged.
